testcases.title: TC-GEO-663-001 - Overview: KPI row shows exactly 4 cards without SOV

steps.title: Given a user is authenticated and navigates to the Overview dashboard
When the Performance KPI row renders
Then exactly 4 KPI cards are displayed in order: Visibility, Avg Position, AI Choice, Sentiment
And no "Share of Voice" KPI card is rendered
And no Good/Fair/Poor quality pill for Share of Voice is rendered

testcases.title: TC-GEO-663-003 - Overview: Brand Rankings table has no SoV% column

steps.title: Given a user is authenticated and navigates to the Overview dashboard
When the Brand Rankings table renders
Then the table columns are exactly: Rank, Brand, Visibility%, Avg Position, LLM Choice%
And there is no SoV% column header and no SoV% cell in any parent or variant row

testcases.title: TC-GEO-663-005 - Brand Rankings default sort is Visibility% descending with correct Rank order

steps.title: Given a user is on the Overview or a Category view with the Brand Rankings table visible
When no explicit user sort is applied
Then the table rows are ordered by Visibility% descending
And the Rank column reflects that order with rank 1 assigned to the brand with the highest Visibility%
And the target brand highlight (trophy icon / "YOU" badge + amber row) is still rendered correctly

testcases.title: TC-GEO-663-006 - No SOV-related tooltips or i18n keys are visible after removal

steps.title: Given a user is on the Overview or a Category view after the SOV removal
When the KPI row and Brand Rankings table are rendered
Then no SOV-specific tooltip text or raw i18n key placeholder is visible in the UI

testcases.title: TC-GEO-664-001 - SOV dedicated card renders below KPI row on Overview

steps.title: Given a user is authenticated and navigates to the Overview dashboard with data available
When the page finishes loading
Then a full-width "Share of Voice" card is visible directly below the KPI card row
And the card displays the title "Share of Voice" and the subtitle "By brand, your brand is highlighted"
And a doughnut chart comparing the target brand against top competitors is rendered inside the card

testcases.title: TC-GEO-664-003 - Doughnut shows top 10 brands + Others slice with callouts and legend

steps.title: Given the SOV doughnut chart is rendered with data containing more than 10 brands
When the chart finishes rendering
Then the doughnut shows exactly the top 10 brands by SOV descending plus one "Others" slice aggregating all remaining share
And each arc >= ~2% displays an outside percentage callout
And arcs with a value below ~2% have their callout hidden but their brand still appears in the legend
And a bottom-centered legend lists each brand with a color dot, name, and bold SOV percentage ordered by SOV desc with "Others" last

testcases.title: TC-GEO-664-004 - Target brand in top 10: arc emphasized and center label shows brand SOV

steps.title: Given the SOV doughnut renders and the target brand is among the top 10 brands by SOV
When the doughnut finishes rendering
Then the target brand's arc is structurally emphasized (e.g. larger radius) relative to competitor arcs
And the persistent center label shows the target brand's name, SOV value, and "Share of Voice" — even when it is not the largest slice
